subject.title: [Control UI] 部分模块中文翻译缺失

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as the broad Control UI zh-CN tab-localization tracker and sequence the partial open PRs through generated i18n output, or supersede it with a broader localization tracker?
rationale: Current source still reproduces the tab-localization gap, but multiple open PRs and adjacent broader/docs localization reports require maintainer sequencing and scope boundaries before automated repair is safe.

options.title: Keep as Control UI tracker
options.body: Use this issue to coordinate focused Control UI tab-localization PRs and keep broader CLI/docs/channel localization elsewhere.

options.title: Supersede with broader localization tracker
options.body: Close or de-prioritize this issue only after a maintainer chooses a single broader canonical issue that preserves the tab-specific evidence.

options.title: Narrow to one tab family
options.body: Retitle or split this issue so one owner can land only a bounded tab surface while other gaps move to separate issues.

recommendation.title: Keep as Control UI tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue to coordinate focused Control UI tab-localization PRs and keep broader CLI/docs/channel localization elsewhere.

likelyOwner.reason: The i18n pipeline and generated-locale ownership evidence makes this the best available routing candidate for the scope decision.
